verdict.rationale: n8n documents a large public workflow-template library: its workflows page advertises 12,116–12,326 community automation workflows, and the GitHub README cites 9,000+ templates. That is a real first-party starting point instead of building from scratch. However, the evidence never shows how a user imports or instantiates a template in the editor, and does not address curation or quality of community-sourced templates. missing for 10: documented import/use-template flow into a workspace, evidence of template curation/verification, independent hands-on corroboration of starting from a template.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can start from a public library of workflow templates instead of building from scratch
